source_manifest.selection_rule: scan response.jsonl in original order; keep split=test, quality=good, task_type=QA records with nonblank question/passages/response within UTF-8 byte limits and a labels list; expected_supported is 1 iff labels is empty (authors' baseline treats implicit_true spans as unsupported); take the first 3 supported and first 3 unsupported cases whose source_id has not already been selected, stopping once both quotas of 3 are filled

selection: Mechanically selected before model predictions: first3zero-span and3nonempty-span good-quality testQA responses with6distinct sources and fixed length bounds. No model outputs used.
prediction_rule: Ragas automatic score==1 -> fully supported; score<1 -> not fully supported. No threshold tuning after outcomes.
reference_rule: Any original labelled span, including implicit_true, counts as not fully source-supported. This is our response-level diagnostic mapping, not full paper span-metric replication.
gold_policy: Prediction code does not open gold. A separate offline grader runs only after prediction process exits, checking frozen input/protocol/gold/grader hashes and exhaustive6case partition.
failure_policy: First failure stops group; keep completed, failed and not-run cases. Incomplete group has no reference agreement aggregate. No resampling or cap reset.
limitations: Known public annotated dataset may be in model pretraining; no unseen holdout or absolute blinding claim.
Six purposive length-bounded QA cases are not representative or startup investment evaluation.
Human span annotations are supplied external references, not independently certified universal truth.
No model/agent superiority, official benchmark score or aggregate investment accuracy claim.
Raw contexts and annotations remain local; only hashes, case IDs and reviewed receipts committed.
